desc: Count the frequency of each of the 26 letters in `s` and store the list of non‑zero counts.
Implement the algorithm: iterate `k` from 0 to `n`, compute per‑letter cost = `min(c, abs(c-k))` (with `k==0` case = `c`), add extra‑insert cost `max(0, num_used*k - n)`, and keep the global minimum.
Optimize the inner loop by using only the pre‑computed list of non‑zero counts and tracking `num_used` when the keep‑option is chosen.
Return the minimum cost from the `Solution.makeStringGood` method.
Verify correctness on the three examples and a few edge cases (all same letter, string of length 3, maximum length 2·10⁴).
Ensure time complexity O(26·n) = O(n) and space O(1) for the 26 counters.
